quest.title: Ever So Close
quest.description: As agreed, you gain Dori's trust. Now, it is finally time to discuss "business" with Alhaitham.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x575, Primogem x30, Mora x22775, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: Through Mists of Smoke and Forests Dark

talks.objective: Go to Wikala Funduq to look for Alhaitham

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: You two made it. And from the looks on your faces, you were successful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there's so many people from the Akademiya here! Why would you pick this place as our meet-up spot?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Well, Wikala Funduq is under the Akademiya's control, so naturally, the Akademiya has people working here. I came to Port Ormos under the pretense of conducting official business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're a pretty daring guy...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Relax, no one here is interested in anything we say, and the matra won't come here. Okay now, tell me how your encounter with Dori went.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You bring Alhaitham up to date and give him the Canned Knowledge you purchased...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, we did what you asked. So, can you tell us about the Knowledge Capsule that the Akademiya lost now?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Before that, I have to ask — why are you two so intent on tracking it down? You don't have to answer, of course.

choices.text: It's not a secret or anything.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yeah, {M#he}{F#she} just wants to meet the God of Wisdom and ask her about something important. We've been in Sumeru for a while now, but we still haven't found a way.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: When we heard that the Akademiya had lost something that might be related to the gods, we came here in case it turned out to be our lucky break.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: In that case, you're on the right track.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: A short while ago, the Akademiya lost a Knowledge Capsule in the desert. It's supposedly a Divine Knowledge Capsule — use it, and you'll gain the wisdom of the gods.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wow, there's really such a thing as that!? Hey, if we find it, do you think we could learn how to meet the Dendro Archon? Ooh, or how to find your {M#sister}{F#brother}?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I highly doubt it has any mystical properties, but it does indeed exist, and it's right here in Port Ormos.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... where exactly?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: That's what we need to find out next.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Your goal is to find it, too?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I won't deny that. I am investigating because I'm curious as to what the Divine Knowledge Capsule truly is.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: As you know, the Eremites in Port Ormos also have their eyes on it. It is an extremely precious item. The knowledge contained within may bring great power or wealth to whoever has it in their possession.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Several brigades have been vying for ownership of it as of late, but there is still no victor.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: My personal finances and connections cannot compete with those of the Eremites. After attempting various methods, I finally managed to reach a tentative agreement with several brigades.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I agreed to forego ownership of the Divine Knowledge Capsule in exchange for the opportunity to study it. After all, there's no harm in understanding what it is.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: However, there are those who are less amenable to negotiation, such as those from Ayn Al-Ahmar.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: They adamantly believe that the Divine Knowledge Capsule contains King Deshret's power, and that he will return to this world when they obtain it. They refuse to let anyone from the Akademiya tarnish their deity's soul.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So you kept hounding them because they refused to cooperate with you?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Yes. Ayn Al-Ahmar isn't exactly wealthy, but its members are determined to get that capsule by any means necessary. To that end, they've resorted to many methods more foul than fair in order to amass sufficient funds.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: So, I've been sabotaging their business to force them into negotiating with me.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: The Divine Knowledge Capsule should be up for a secret auction within the next few days. Each brigade will place their own bid, and the prize will be covertly given to the winner.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: To ensure the capsule's security and to evade the matra's notice, the winning brigade will not publicly disclose their victory.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Unless I know whose hands the Divine Knowledge Capsule ends up in, my agreements with them will fall through.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Dori is the most reliable source of information, but that avenue was previously closed to me. With you on board now, the situation is different.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In other words, you wanted us to befriend Dori so you could find out where the Divine Knowledge Capsule is?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Yes, you can say that, but this arrangement harms none of us.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: The day after tomorrow, go back to Dori and try to purchase information on the Divine Knowledge Capsule's whereabouts. If she has no information, wait two days and approach her again.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: If I get the opportunity to study the Divine Knowledge Capsule, I will relay my findings to you. Will that suffice as compensation?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Okay. Then we'll meet up in two days.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alhaitham, before you go! We actually bought a Knowledge Capsule for ourselves, but we're not sure how to use it.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: You two want to try using a Knowledge Capsule? Sure, I can teach you.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Doing so right under the Akademiya's nose is a bit problematic, though. What do you say we head to the outskirts of town.

choices.text: We want to meet with the Dendro Archon.

talks.objective: Go out into the wilds to test the Canned Knowledge

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Alright, this place works. Show me the capsule you purchased.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Hm, Swordfighting Techniques VIII... A combat-class Knowledge Capsule. This class is something of a rare find these days, since most have been taken by the Eremites to augment their battle capabilities.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Really? Aw yeah, what a great buy!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: If you want to determine the efficacy of this capsule, I can evaluate your combat ability. However, effects will likely be minimal if you already possess a high amount of strength.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: We can conduct a controlled experiment where you fight two battles: one before using this Knowledge Capsule, and one after.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: While you fight, we can use an Akasha Terminal to monitor your various physical parameters.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: There may be variances in your physical strength between the two tests, as well as a disparity in your opponents' abilities... But don't worry, I'll run statistical analyses afterward to mitigate any confounding effects.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... Alhaitham, you must've been one of those guys at the Akademiya who got top grades on everything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's curious about something, though. You definitely weren't one of those students who needed Canned Knowledge to graduate from the Akademiya, right? So why are you risking getting caught by the matra for this capsule?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm also curious about this.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: When you are unable to understand a researcher's actions, most cases can be attributed to curiosity. This is but one theory.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Sounds like you're trying to avoid the question.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Alright, let's begin the test. Just fight as you normally do.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll link your Akasha Terminal to record data.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: The next step is to use this Knowledge Capsule.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Hold it in your hand. I'll help you establish a connection with it so you can activate its power.

talks.objective: Open your Inventory and use the Canned Knowledge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I feel like I just had an epiphany...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (As if I saw countless sword-wielding figures fighting one moment, and then in the next, they disappeared into the recesses of my memory.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, how are you feeling?

choices.text: I felt something for a moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mean that it worked?

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Alright, time for round two. Fight with the same composure as before.

choices.text: Whatever was inside the Knowledge Capsule became a part of my memory.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Here, over here! Welcome back, my loyal patrons. What can I do for you this time?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: You name it! Canned Knowledge, supplies, or anything else you need, I'll find a way to get it... Where there's a waterfall of Mora, there's a way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can you really get us anything we want? Anything at all?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Aha! So it appears that Canned Knowledge alone is no longer sufficient for your opulent appetite? Then please, oblige me, tell me what you have in mind!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to buy info on the whereabouts of the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Oh, hehehe! I knew customers with pockets as deep as yours would undoubtedly crave something more profound than ordinary Canned Knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: But you know, that kind of information isn't going to be cheap.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: After all, I had to work really hard to weasel my way into the auction site. Not to mention that if anyone found out that I was the leaker, I would be in big, big trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how can we be sure your information is accurate? Paimon's curious how you just happen to have this kind of info the moment we need it.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Because to me, anything of value is what I consider to be my supply. Therefore, I must always be aware of what's hot on the market in order to secure more sales.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: As for the information's authenticity, well, you've no need to worry about that. I used a Kamera to take a picture of the transaction. That way, no one can dispute it.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: It's always a pleasure doing business with such sterling patrons.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ahem, now that you've paid in full, here's the scoop: The Divine Knowledge Capsule was purchased yesterday by a certain Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ayn Al-Ahmar? You mean the Eremites who worship King Deshret?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Ah, so you're already familiar with them.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: The group has done everything in their power to obtain the Divine Knowledge Capsule. After all, they believe it contains the power of King Deshret.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: That Divine Knowledge Capsule is unlike any other Canned Knowledge I've seen before. It was glowing bright red.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: The capsule is clearly visible in the picture I took. You can look for yourself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks for the info, Dori.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Please, it's my pleasure. It's all thanks to discerning customers such as yourselves that my efforts yesterday were not in vain. Please, don't hesitate to contact me if you ever need anything else in the future — Mora for Dori opens doors!

talks.objective: Ask Alhaitham about the test results

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Now, I'll start recording data again.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alhaitham, how's it going?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: #Well, the Knowledge Capsule you purchased did improve {M#his}{F#her} combat capability. During the second fight, {M#his}{F#her} overall fighting performance increased by 0.073%.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... how much?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaarrrgh! Dori's such a jerk! She totally scammed us! One million Mora? This thing isn't worth a tenth of that amount!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: #Of course, this could be because {M#he}{F#she} is so powerful that the capsule's contents were unable to produce a substantial increase.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: At the very least, this test allowed me to gain more insight into you two. Our deal seems increasingly worth my investment.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: I'm heading back to the Wikala Funduq. I await your response in two days' time. This is Mora for when you ask Dori for information. Pay her as much as she requests.

talks.objective: Wait until 07:00 two days from now
Go ask Dori about the whereabouts of the Divine Knowledge Capsule

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alhaitham! We got the info you wanted!

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Really? Alright, let's hear it.

choices.text: It's in the hands of Ayn Al-Ahmar.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dori even gave us evidence to verify the intel. Have a look!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Huh, look at that... clear as day. It must have taken some guts just to infiltrate the scene of the Eremites' transaction. But then to get close enough to take a picture like this... Bold move, Dori. Very bold move.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Alright, the person in this picture is indeed Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar, and the glowing red capsule he's holding appears to be the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: In which case, if we play our cards right, when we confront them next week, we should be able to force them to show their hand.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At first, Paimon didn't get why you were provoking these Ayn Al-Ahmar guys, but now it sorta makes sense. Everything's playing right into your hands.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After we defeat them, we can finally have a serious talk with their boss and get him to lend us the Divine Knowledge Capsule!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Thank you for your time and efforts. Take a few days off while I make some preparations. Let's meet up again on the afternoon of the arranged date, three o'clock sharp.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We'll be there.

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: See you then.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: A few days later, on the day of the meeting with Ayn Al-Ahmar...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alhaitham sure is taking his time. Where could he be? Oh, there he is!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Sorry to keep you waiting. Let's head to the pier in front of Pharos Lighthouse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, let's go!

choices.text: The very group that we're about to face.

dialogues.speaker: Tariq
dialogues.text: Alhaitham... I knew you were crazy, but I didn't know you were crazy enough to actually show up.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It was I who demanded that these negotiations take place. I was more worried that you might go back on your promise, but to your credit, it appears that you're sticking to your word.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: This is turning into quite an occasion. I also brought some backup — I assume you don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Tariq
dialogues.text: Backup? Aren't you the brat from the restaurant the other day? You've come to support this lunatic because he helped you out? Hmph, fine, your funeral.

dialogues.speaker: Tariq
dialogues.text: I'm not going to mince my words: once we're done with you, you'll be nothing more than fish food. Get 'em, boys!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh, here they come! Uh, good luck you two!

talks.objective: Exchange "pointed words" with the members of Ayn Al-Ahmar

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? What in Teyvat just happened? It's like that big guy suddenly lost his mind...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: It looks like he used the Divine Knowledge Capsule.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean, the Divine Knowledge Capsule did that to him?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Haypasia did mention...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, you mean how some researchers go insane after getting knowledge from Irminsul?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I've heard of numerous incidents of researchers in Satyavada Life going insane. The state that man is now in suggests that this is a similar situation.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: This Divine Knowledge Capsule does appear to be linked to the gods, but beyond that, it doesn't seem anything like the rumors suggest. Possessing it doesn't grant you divine wisdom or power.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Did you hear what he said? "World... forget me..." What could that possibly mean?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (That's exactly what I heard before at Irminsul...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If the matra took him away, then that means the Akademiya got the Divine Knowledge Capsule back, too. What a shame, we were so close...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, Paimon didn't expect the Divine Knowledge Capsule would be so dangerous. Imagine if we'd tried to open it... Who knows what would've happened to us...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: As things stand, there is no reason for me to remain in Port Ormos. I believe our collaboration has also reached its end.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, we were so busy trying to find the Divine Knowledge Capsule that Paimon forgot to ask you something! Since you're a member of the Akademiya, do you have any idea how we can go about meeting Lesser Lord Kusanali?

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Truthfully, I don't. Lesser Lord Kusanali appears to exist outside of Sumeru's entire administration. Most of the time, you wouldn't know she exists at all.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: Moreover, since the Akademiya possesses the Akasha, a symbol of our deity's wisdom, scholars have no reason to desire to make contact with the deity herself anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Everything about Lesser Lord Kusanali is such a mystery.

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: I'm heading back to the Akademiya. How about you two?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aah, it's almost the day of the Sabzeruz Festival! Maybe we should head back, too. We've been rushed off our feet over the past few days, so maybe a little rest and relaxation will do us good.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then we'll part ways here, Alhaitham. Until we meet again!

response.speaker: Alhaitham
response.text: Hmm... Now, do I deal with this thing first, or should I produce the report that the higher-ups require?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hee-hee-hee, Mora, Mora, shiny Mora... Hee-hee-hee...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: ...Oh! Uh, please come back any time you need something!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Remember to bring a token of our friendship the next time we meet, okay? I like to think it's built on a firm foundation of solid, shining Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: (Alhaitham lifts his chin and looks into the distance, seemingly waiting for you to provide battle data.)

dialogues.speaker: Alhaitham
dialogues.text: (Alhaitham is, as he was previously, waiting for you to provide a new batch of combat data.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Our dealings with Dori went smoothly enough. Let's head to Wikala Funduq and meet up with Alhaitham.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hopefully now, he'll finally tell us about what the Akademiya lost.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see Dori today and ask her about where the Divine Knowledge Capsule is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we figured out where the Divine Knowledge Capsule is! It turns out it ended up in the hands of Ayn Al-Ahmar.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's head back and talk to Alhaitham!
